planning_note: HISTORICAL 2-year default rate of the frozen eligible cohort, used as a pre-treatment PLANNING PROXY for the control arm. It is not an observed control outcome; no simulated outcome existed when this was frozen.

dgp_params.decision_rule: SHIP only if BOTH hold on POLICY-TRAIN ∪ POLICY-VAL: (1) CUPED-adjusted spend lift point estimate >= spend_mde_dollars AND its 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0; (2) default non-inferiority PASSES at delta_noninf_pp via the one-sided 95% Newcombe upper bound. Otherwise DO NOT SHIP at the ATE level (Layer 3 may still identify a feasible targeted segment policy).
